At the current tip, `withTickLock` races `fn()` against `lostSignal`; if `lost` resolves first, the race rejects and the `finally` block releases the lock while the original `fn()` promise is still pending. `fn` has no cancellation signal, and `Promise.race` does not cancel it, so checkout/restore/config-write work can continue after lock loss and after another holder acquires the lock. This is an ordinary lock-correctness defect in the existing lost-detection behavior; no current-contract clause accepts it.
